name: talk-deck-handoff
procedure: propose presentation content from a source document, review and fact-check it, then build the deck
why: One procedure: propose slide content from a named source, fact-check it against the source and cut to a slide limit, confirm the format, build the deck. The review prompt is a checkpoint on the proposal, not a new job. Source: HANDOFF.md. Recorded 2026-09-17 on a cleaned concept_buddy (earlier decks moved out), model claude-sonnet-5, scripted prompts pasted verbatim — so prompt wording is near-identical across runs of one procedure, which flatters any matcher that reads prompts.
history: Live capture: conversation matching (prompts + replies, 0.88) grouped these by source file rather than procedure — a presentation and a LinkedIn post on ARTICLE.md scored 0.852, two presentations on different files 0.831. Recorded to measure what to embed.
